title: Bounded cohomological dimension and commutation with direct sums make the extension by zero of the structure sheaf compact

difficulty_reason: The lemma gives conditions under which j_!O_U is compact in the derived category: bounded cohomological dimension on U together with commutation of the cohomology functors with direct sums (statement lines 14135-14145). The proof (proof lines 14147-14164) reduces compactness to commutation of R Gamma(U, -) with direct sums, chooses K-injective representatives of the summands, and computes the derived functor on that complex of acyclics. H2: one reduction and one resolution argument, written out.
